target.price: Free €0 · Plus €49.99/mo · Pro €129.99/mo · Executive on request. Yearly billing 20% off.

candidates.buyer: Independent consignment/resale shop owners (50-300+ active consignors) running their own payout cycles instead of enterprise POS software
candidates.job: Monthly consignor payout reconciliation: matching sold items and splits against sales reports/inventory counts, plus consignor W-9 intake and year-end 1099 issuance as a distinct AP process

candidates.buyer: Individual online resellers (eBay/Poshmark/Mercari/Etsy sellers with multi-state nexus) who sell only through marketplace facilitators and assume platform tax collection ends their state filing duties
candidates.job: Multi-state sales-tax back office for marketplace-only sellers: determine which states still require a permit, informational return, or zero-dollar/total-sales return despite facilitator collection, file on schedule, and answer state notices

candidates.buyer: Tax preparers (EAs/CPAs) and donors with itemized noncash donations of used goods over $500 given to thrift-funded nonprofits (Goodwill-type, Habitat ReStore, church thrift shops)
candidates.job: Produce an itemized, defensible thrift-shop fair-market-value schedule per donated lot (IRS Form 8283 Section B), so preparers don't estimate values for goods they never saw and donors get audit-ready documentation
